    for k,v in new.items():

            assert (ROOT/v).is_file(),v
    config_changes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/')]=[k for k in updates if old.get(k)!=new.get(k)]
    new_content[p]=(json.dumps(new,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n').encode('utf-8')
